stories.description: Python and native imports match the selected installed wheel.
Positive bounded millisecond timeouts serialize as Rust durations, and JavaScript stays opt-in.
File and local module graphs are captured when authored, and the selected module export is evaluated.
Typed Contract assertions require explicit local predicates before a browser is acquired.
require_completed accepts only completed outcomes without stop, skip, failure, cancellation, or uncertain cleanup and step receipts.
BoundFlow JavaScript opt-in returns a new bound recipe and does not mutate the original Flow or policy.

PageRequest can use retained Session or Work browser ownership, bind an explicit browser policy, return a typed current-document Cart, reject DirectHttp fallback, and preserve ownership after pre-dispatch cancellation.
Managed and borrowed Flow invocation preserve ownership, enforce JavaScript permission, and stop after false or raising predicates.
Cancellation preserves the scoped Until receipt and prevents a later action from dispatching.
Cancellation returns while a local predicate remains blocked, keeps the asyncio loop responsive, and leaves the borrowed Work reusable after the predicate releases.
Cancellation before acquisition or dispatch creates no loopback business effect.
